create.name: Camille Maurine
create.bio:
Camille Maurine is a meditation mentor, dancer and writer based in Marina del Rey, California, whose teaching brings meditation, movement and creative expression together, with a particular focus on women's spiritual life and embodiment. With her husband, the meditation teacher Lorin Roche, she developed Instinctive Meditation, an approach that encourages each person to find practices that suit their own nature rather than follow a fixed method, and together they founded the Radiance Sutras School of Meditation. She has also performed movement pieces drawn from The Radiance Sutras, Lorin's rendering of the Vijnana Bhairava Tantra.

Camille and Lorin co-wrote Meditation 24/7, a collection of short practices for the moments of an ordinary day, and before it Meditation Secrets for Women. For years she has guided an online circle of women through the twelve secrets of her first book, training some of them to facilitate the work themselves, and she created a process called Moving Theater of the Soul. She offers private sessions in person, by phone or on Zoom, using meditation, breath, voice and expressive movement, and has taught at Esalen, Kripalu and 1440 Multiversity.

books.title: Meditation Secrets for Women: Discovering Your Passion, Pleasure, and Inner Peace
books.author: Camille Maurine, Lorin Roche
books.description: Camille and Lorin's guide to meditation as women actually experience it, encouraging readers to trust their own rhythms and feelings rather than force a single technique.

books.title: Meditation 24/7: Practices to Enlighten Every Moment of the Day
books.author: Camille Maurine, Lorin Roche
books.description: Brief essays and practices for points in an everyday routine, from waking to falling asleep, first published with an audio CD of the two authors guiding the meditations.

courses.title: Private Sessions in Soulful Embodiment with Camille Maurine
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in person, by phone or on Zoom, shaped around what each person brings. They may include tailored meditation, subtle and expressive movement, breathwork and voice.

courses.title: Radiance Sutras Meditation Teacher Training (200 hours, online)
courses.description: A six-month online training in Instinctive Meditation from the Radiance Sutras School of Meditation, with live classes during the week and Yoga Alliance certification at 200 hours. Dates for the next round are sent to those who register interest.
